content: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner on Windows Server as a Windows Service makes outbound-only HTTPS long-polling connections to GitHub (no inbound ports needed) — fits IIS server with no public GitHub access. Workflow runs composer install --no-dev on the runner, then copies/robocopies built app to IIS physical path; only use self-hosted runners on private/trusted repos, never on public repos or with fork PRs (arbitrary code execution risk on production box).
